english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a sudden strong impulse to do something.
Use 衝動 as the all-purpose noun for an irresistible inner urge to do something.

examples.english: I suddenly had an urge to quit immediately.
examples.traditional: 我突然有衝動，想即刻辭職。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dat6 jin4 jau5 cung1 dung6 soeng2 zik1 hak1 ci4 zik1

examples.english: I know I’ll go bankrupt if I keep buying, but once that compulsion hits, I can’t stop.
examples.traditional: 我明知再買落去會破產，但嗰股衝動一嚟就停唔到。
